lead.t: Pulmonary valve stenosis (PVS) is a heart valve disorder.

snip.t: Pulmonary valve stenosis (PVS) is a heart valve disorder.
In pulmonary valve stenosis this opening is too narrow, leading to a reduction of flow of blood to the lungs.

When you have an obstructive lesion (aortic valve stenosis, pulmonary valve stenosis, coarct etc) if its in the mild to moderate or begining of the\nsevere stage it is Acyanotic Heart Disease but once it reaches the critical i.e. very severe then it becomes Cyanotic Heart Disease
Noonan Syndrome: Dysplastic pulmonary valve stenosis, hypertrophic cardiomyopathy

qs.q: A 4-year-old child is diagnosed with isolated mild pulmonary valve stenosis during an evaluation for a murmur. Which management strategy is most appropriate?
o: Administration of daily prophylactic oral diuretics
Conservative observation with routine clinical follow-up
Immediate surgical replacement of the pulmonary valve
qs.e: Mild pulmonary stenosis is hemodynamically insignificant and managed conservatively with clinical observation. Invasive interventions like balloon valvuloplasty are reserved for moderate to severe cases.
